column1: # DEV-e: local LLM (llm, llama.cpp on Vulkan, started on demand, unloaded after 5 idle minutes). Format: see the header of ~/.config/hub/hub.

column9: Package and Vulkan device, the active model and whether it is downloaded, the socket and whether the model is loaded right now (with its memory). Never loads the model.

A tiny chat with the local model in this terminal (history only in memory, Ctrl+D quits, /reset clears it). The first message loads the model (about 1.5 s), five idle minutes after the last one it is unloaded again.

column6: llm stop && notify-send -a llm 'Local LLM unloaded'
column9: Stops the server now: the model leaves memory and the GPU. The socket keeps listening, so the next request loads it again.
Pick the active model from the catalogue (downloaded ones only; the active one is first). A loaded server restarts with the new model, an idle one uses it at its next start.

Downloads the default model (Qwen3.5 2B Q4_K_M, 1.3 GB) from Hugging Face into ~/.local/share/llm/models: resumable, the pinned sha256 is checked before it is used. More models: llm models list, llm models fetch NAME.

Speed (prompt and generation tokens per second, first token, cold start, GPU memory) and a small quality set (translation, layout fixes, commit messages) of the active model. Takes about half a minute and stops the model at the end.
